__HIDDENCAT__
This hidden maintenance category collects pages with a <code><nowiki>{{SpellTooltip}}</nowiki></code> whose <code>stablekey</code> matches no spell in the game data. Often a game update renamed or removed the spell.

To fix a page, give the template the current key of the spell, or remove the template. See [[Erenshor Wiki:Game Data#Maintenance categories]].
